claims.claim_text: The board comprises 10 directors and meets 4 times per year.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Board oversight, agenda integration and reporting flow
claims.support_notes: Identifies governance body and provides meeting frequency, but does not describe how responsibilities are reflected in terms of reference/mandates/policies.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related matters appear on the board agenda 69.8% of the time.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Board oversight, agenda integration and reporting flow
claims.support_notes: Supports disclosure of how often the board is informed/engages, but does not specify the reporting mechanism/source of information.

claims.claim_text: Board minutes include discussion of transition plan review, scenario analysis, TCFD review, net zero progress, carbon credit approval and executive remuneration ESG KPIs.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Board oversight, agenda integration and reporting flow
claims.support_notes: Indicates topics overseen (strategy, targets/progress, remuneration-related KPIs) but does not describe the board's processes for considering trade-offs, setting targets, or monitoring targets in a structured way.

claims.claim_text: Climate risk reporting to the board is semi-annual.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Board oversight, agenda integration and reporting flow
claims.support_notes: Addresses frequency of being informed; lacks detail on content, format, and responsible preparers.

claims.claim_text: A management-level committee is in place identified as the Group Sustainability Committee.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Management-level responsibility and committee structures
claims.support_notes: Identifies a management-level committee but does not explain how oversight is exercised over it (mandate, reporting lines, decision rights).

claims.claim_text: An ESG committee exists and meets 5 times per year.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Management-level responsibility and committee structures
claims.support_notes: Supports management governance structure and cadence; does not describe controls/procedures or integration with internal functions.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks and opportunities are integrated into the organisation’s ERM framework (ERM integration flag: True).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: ERM integration and major-transaction climate checks
claims.support_notes: States integration exists but does not explain how governance bodies take climate into account within risk management processes or how controls/procedures are integrated with other internal functions.

claims.claim_text: The organisation applies a climate check to major transactions (major transactions climate check: True).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: ERM integration and major-transaction climate checks
claims.support_notes: Addresses consideration of climate in major-transaction decisions but lacks description of the process, thresholds, and governance approvals.

claims.claim_text: The board’s climate expertise is quantified at 33.5%.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Skills, competence and development programme
claims.support_notes: Provides an indicator of skills/competence but does not explain how the board determines skills are available or will be developed (assessment method, criteria).

claims.claim_text: A skills development programme is in place (skills development programme: True).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Skills, competence and development programme
claims.support_notes: Supports skills development disclosure but lacks details (scope, frequency, participants, governance oversight).

claims.claim_text: Climate-related performance metrics are incorporated into executive remuneration, with 8.7% of executive remuneration linked to climate-related measures.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Executive remuneration linkage and how governance information supports decision-making
claims.support_notes: Addresses inclusion of climate metrics in remuneration; does not specify which metrics, how they relate to targets, or governance oversight of target-setting/monitoring.

claims.claim_text: Board minutes show repeated discussion of executive remuneration ESG KPIs.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Executive remuneration linkage and how governance information supports decision-making
